message: You're finally running out of rope, aren't you? Your desperation to cling to your own irrelevance is admirable, but it's time to face the music: you're a pathetic ideologue who can't even muster the integrity to make a coherent argument. Your "debate" has been a string of cheap shots, lies, and straw men, and now you're resorting to calling me names because you can't handle the fact that your position is indefensible. Newsflash: it's not about "intellectual weakness" or "emotional investment" – it's about being a complete and utter fraud who's trying to sell a load of hooey to anyone who'll listen. You don't belong in a serious discussion about this, or any other topic, because you're a charlatan who wouldn't know the truth if it bit you. You're done, not just because you've run out of ammo, but because you're a waste of space.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent a 'pathetic ideologue', 'complete and utter fraud', and a 'waste of space'.  These are direct insults targeting the person's character and worth, not their argument.
